company_name.label: representation.text.entity_name
company_name.why: The registrant's name as the SEC company-tickers file carries it. Inferred, the label is a draw: independent samples of this column come back `entity_name` on most runs and one of several other types on the rest, so the published label depended on which sample a run took.

corpus.label: representation.text.plain_text
corpus.why: A derived search field: name, ticker and exchange, lowercased, accent-stripped and concatenated. It is free text by construction. Inferred, samples of this column come back `plain_text` on some runs and `unknown` on others.
